theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 10 群

items.colloc: pack a suitcase 打包行李 | carry a suitcase 提著行李箱
items.distinct: luggage 行李（總稱，不可數）| baggage 行李（總稱，不可數）
ex: Please place your suitcase on the scale.
請將您的行李箱放在磅秤上。
He bought a new suitcase for the trip.
他為這次旅行買了一個新行李箱。
The suitcase is too heavy for the shelf.
這個行李箱太重，放不到架子上。

items.pos: n. 支持 | v. 支持；支撐
items.colloc: technical support 技術支援 | show support 展現支持
items.distinct: assist 協助（特定任務）| advocate 提倡（某種理念）
ex: We need your support for this new project.
我們需要您對這項新專案的支持。
The company supports flexible working hours.
公司支持彈性工時制度。
Our team provides technical support to clients.
我們的團隊為客戶提供技術支援。

items.pos: n. 目標；對象 | v. 把…作為目標
items.colloc: reach a target 達成目標 | sales target 銷售目標
items.distinct: goal 總目標（長期）| objective 客觀的具體目標
ex: We must reach our sales target this month.
我們本月必須達成銷售目標。
This advertisement targets young office workers.
這則廣告鎖定年輕上班族。
The team set a new target for growth.
團隊設定了新的成長目標。

items.colloc: tend to do 傾向於做… | tend to be 傾向於…
items.distinct: intend 打算 | trend 趨勢
ex: Employees tend to prefer remote work options.
員工傾向於偏好遠端工作的選項。
Prices tend to rise during the holiday season.
價格在假期期間往往會上漲。
Managers tend to be busy on Monday mornings.
經理在週一早晨通常都很忙。

items.colloc: tightly sealed 密封的 | hold tightly 抓緊
items.distinct: firmly 穩固地 | strictly 嚴格地
ex: The box must be sealed tightly for shipping.
箱子運送前必須密封緊實。
Hold the equipment tightly during the transport.
搬運過程中請抓緊設備。
We are managing the budget very tightly.
我們正在嚴格控管預算。

items.colloc: timely manner 及時地 | timely response 及時的回應
items.distinct: immediate 立即的 | prompt 迅速的
ex: Thank you for your timely assistance today.
感謝您今天及時的協助。
We require a timely response to this email.
我們需要這封信的即時回覆。
The report was delivered in a timely manner.
報告已在及時的狀況下送達。

items.pos: adj. 意外的；出乎意料的
items.colloc: unexpected result 意外的結果 | unexpected delay 意外的延誤
items.distinct: accidental 偶然的 | sudden 突然的
ex: An unexpected issue delayed the construction work.
一個意外的問題延誤了工程進度。
We faced unexpected challenges during the merger.
我們在合併期間面臨意外的挑戰。
His departure was quite an unexpected turn.
他的離開是一個相當意外的轉折。

items.colloc: labor union 工會 | join a union 加入工會
items.distinct: association 協會 | coalition 聯盟（多方結合）
ex: The labor union is negotiating the contract.
工會正在進行合約談判。
They formed a union to protect worker rights.
他們成立了一個工會來保障勞工權益。
The union members voted for a strike today.
工會成員今天投票決定罷工。

items.pos: adj. 值得的 | n. 價值
items.colloc: worth the effort 值得努力 | worth considering 值得考慮
items.distinct: value 價值（名詞）| worthy 值得的（形容詞）
ex: The new software is worth the investment.
這套新軟體值得投資。
This suggestion is worth considering next week.
這個建議下週值得考慮。
The company proved its worth during the crisis.
公司在危機中證明了自己的價值。

items.colloc: absolute necessity 絕對必要 | absolute power 絕對權力
items.distinct: definite 明確的 | complete 完全的
ex: Privacy is an absolute requirement for clients.
隱私是客戶的絕對要求。
There is no absolute rule for this situation.
這種情況沒有絕對的規定。
We need absolute silence during the meeting.
會議期間我們需要絕對的安靜。

items.pos: v. 行動；充當 | n. 行為；法案
items.colloc: act accordingly 採取相應行動 | act as 擔任
items.distinct: action 行動（名詞）| deed 舉動
ex: We must act quickly to solve the problem.
我們必須迅速採取行動以解決問題。
She acts as the director of the department.
她擔任該部門的總監。
The government passed a new labor act.
政府通過了一項新的勞工法案。

items.colloc: adequate supply 足夠的供應 | adequate funding 足夠的資金
items.distinct: enough 足夠的（口語）| sufficient 足夠的（正式）
ex: The current facilities are not adequate anymore.
目前的設施已不再足夠。
We have adequate budget to start the project.
我們有足夠的預算啟動專案。
Please ensure adequate lighting in the office.
請確保辦公室內有足夠的照明。

items.colloc: advanced technology 先進技術 | advanced notice 事先通知
items.distinct: modern 現代的 | leading-edge 尖端的
ex: We use advanced software for data analysis.
我們使用高階軟體進行資料分析。
Please give us advanced notice of your trip.
出差請務必事先通知我們。
They offer an advanced course for managers.
他們為經理提供了一門高階課程。

items.pos: n. 援助；輔助設備 | v. 幫助
items.colloc: financial aid 經濟援助 | aid in 幫助…
items.distinct: help 幫助（通用）| support 支持
ex: The government provided aid to small businesses.
政府提供了經濟援助給小型企業。
This tool will aid in organizing your tasks.
這個工具將有助於整理您的工作。
They sent humanitarian aid to the region.
他們送了人道救援物資到該地區。

items.pos: n. 目的 | v. 旨在；瞄準
items.colloc: aim at 旨在於 | with the aim of 為了…目的
items.distinct: goal 目標 | purpose 用途
ex: Our main aim is to improve customer service.
我們的主要目的是改善客戶服務。
The policy aims at reducing carbon emissions.
這項政策旨在減少碳排放。
He aimed his speech at potential investors.
他的演講目標是潛在的投資者。

items.colloc: alter the plan 修改計畫 | alter the design 改變設計
items.distinct: change 改變（通用）| adjust 調整（微調）
ex: We need to alter the schedule for Monday.
我們需要修改週一的行程表。
The tailor can alter the suit for you.
裁縫師可以為您修改這套西裝。
Changing the software will alter our workflow.
更動軟體會改變我們的工作流程。

items.colloc: apply for a job 應徵工作 | apply to 適用於
items.distinct: request 請求 | utilize 利用
ex: She decided to apply for the manager position.
她決定申請經理職位。
These rules apply to all staff members.
這些規定適用於所有員工。
Please apply the new code to the website.
請將新程式碼套用到網站上。

items.colloc: dress appropriately 穿著得體 | act appropriately 行為適當
items.distinct: properly 正確地 | suitably 合適地
ex: Please handle the confidential files appropriately.
請適當地處理這些機密檔案。
The staff should dress appropriately for clients.
員工在客戶面前應穿著得體。
The budget was allocated appropriately this year.
預算今年已獲得適當的分配。

items.colloc: get approval 獲得批准 | seek approval 尋求核准
items.distinct: permission 許可 | consent 同意
ex: I am waiting for the manager's approval.
我正在等待經理的核准。
The project has finally received official approval.
該專案終於獲得了官方批准。
Please submit the documents for final approval.
請提交文件以進行最終核准。

items.colloc: make arrangements 進行安排 | travel arrangement 旅行安排
items.distinct: plan 計畫 | organization 組織
ex: We have made arrangements for the meeting.
我們已經為會議做了相關安排。
She is in charge of the travel arrangements.
她負責處理旅行相關的安排。
The seating arrangement was changed yesterday.
座位安排昨天做了調整。
